description_en: Updates the content moderation configuration for live streaming
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-snapshot-detect-porn-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig

parameters.help_en: The streaming domain of the streamer
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The AppName value must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). Hyphens and underscores cannot be the first character. The value can also be a single asterisk (*) to match all AppName values
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属的应用名称。AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the stored image that contains violations such as pornography or politically sensitive content
parameters.help_zh: 保存涉黄涉政等违规图片名称
parameters.name: oss_object

parameters.help_en: The sampling interval. Valid values: 5 to 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 采样间隔。取值范围：5-3600。单位：秒
parameters.name: interval
